name: cad
$comment-opencascade: OCCT 8.0.1 (2026-07-30). C++17 minimum. DataExchange toolkits are TKDE*-prefixed since 7.8. VTK deliberately not requested; it is off by default in OCCT 8 anyway. The freetype default feature is kept: dropping it would shed fontconfig/gperf/brotli/libpng, but that is minutes against OCCT's own 30-60, and a USE_FREETYPE=OFF build is unverified — it would fail deep into the OCCT compile, costing a full CI cycle per attempt.
$comment-boost: planegcs needs Boost.Graph (connected_components, to partition a sketch into independent subsystems) and Boost.Math (constants). Header-only, so vcpkg copies headers rather than compiling. Requested instead of patching the vendored solver: reimplementing connected_components would be reinventing, and every edit to vendored code makes the next upstream sync a merge.
$comment-sqlite3: The native document format (ADR 0003). Requested explicitly rather than relying on the platform's copy: macOS and most Linux ship libsqlite3, Windows ships nothing, and assetlib's find_package(SQLite3 QUIET) was silently picking up the system one. A single C file -- seconds to build, and it does not touch OCCT.
$comment-bgfx: bgfx 1.129 with [tools] for shaderc. The tools feature pulls glslang and spirv-tools -- a real but one-time build. Compiling shaders from source beats checking in per-platform binary blobs nobody can regenerate. glfw3 is for the dev viewer only.
